item.title: Microsoft Plans Huge Deployment of Its Own AI Chips
item.description: Microsoft unveiled its Maia 300 custom AI chip and plans extensive deployment in 2027 to improve computing efficiency and reduce infrastructure costs.

item.title: HCLTech Signs Partnership with Anthropic
item.description: HCLTech announced a partnership with Anthropic to promote enterprise adoption of agentic AI, with a dedicated business unit focused on AI solutions.
